name: fillmissing
setup: y = [1 2 NaN 4 5 NaN 7]; ynr = [1 NaN NaN 4 NaN 6]; yends = [NaN NaN 3 NaN 5 NaN NaN]; ylt = [NaN 1 2 NaN 4 NaN]; M = [1 NaN; NaN 4; 3 NaN; 5 8];
expr: fp = fillmissing(y, 'previous'); fn = fillmissing(y, 'next'); fc = fillmissing(y, 'constant', 99); nr = fillmissing(ynr, 'nearest'); ne = fillmissing(yends, 'nearest'); li = fillmissing(ynr, 'linear'); le = fillmissing(yends, 'linear'); lt = fillmissing(ylt, 'linear'); ML = fillmissing(M, 'linear'); MP = fillmissing(M, 'previous');
comment: fillmissing — replace NaN by method. Methods: 'constant', 'previous', 'next' (existing); 'nearest', 'linear' (added cycle 74). Per-column processing for matrices (fixes prior 1D-flat bug for previous/next). Tie-break in 'nearest' picks NEXT. 'linear' extrapolates leading/trailing NaNs via slope of nearest interior good-value pair (requires ≥2 good values). Deferred MATLAB methods: 'spline', 'pchip', 'makima', 'movmean', 'movmedian', 'knn'.
